evidence.claim: Full kill chain on FIN-WKS-014: malicious xlsm -> hidden encoded powershell -> rundll32 svchost-helper.dll implant -> comsvcs LSASS dump -> 7z archive of FS-01 Finance share -> vssadmin+wbadmin anti-recovery.
vssadmin's parent is svchost-helper.dll implant and sits in a malware chain, not legitimate admin maintenance.
Data exfiltration: FIN-WKS-014 sent ~4.8GB over SSL to external 203.0.113.66:443 at 13:11, minutes after 7z archiving of the FS-01 Finance share.
Single EDR ProcessRollup2 record on FIN-WKS-014 at 14:02:11Z: vssadmin.exe delete shadows /all /quiet ran as UserName alice.morgan, parent svchost-helper.dll (ParentProcessId 6402).
EDR ProcessRollup2 on FIN-WKS-014: powershell.exe -nop -w hidden -enc (TargetProcessId 6188), parent EXCEL.EXE PID 6120, UserName alice.morgan.
Over the whole data range the only Windows Security record mentioning svc-monitor is the single 4728 group-add at 11:43. No 4624, 4768, 4672 or any other event has TargetUserName=svc-monitor.
